source: Aircon

source: Mug
target: 杯子

source: Aerostat
target: 浮空艇

source: XANADU Air Freight[NW Core
target: 上都航空货运[西北核心区

source: &1676 This is the place...
&704 It looks like this aircon was busted recently. Maybe street punks, but thanks to the addictive properties of the Trance, you don't see so many of those about anymore. A mixed blessing.
target: &704 这台空调看着刚被弄坏不久。也许是街头混混干的，可迷境让人上瘾，街上已经很少见到那种人。倒也不全是坏事。

source: &712 That aircon's putting out a lot of heat. Must be working pretty hard in this weather.
target: &712 这台空调排出好多热气。这种天气，肯定忙坏了。

source: &713 All this vandalism...maybe people are right, perhaps too much Trancing really *is* warping my morals and principles.
target: &713 搞了这么多破坏……也许别人说得对，过度沉迷迷境，*确实*扭曲了我的道德和原则。

source: &714 Man, I can't wait to get back in the Trance.
target: &714 真想赶快回到迷境里。

source: &715 It doesn't appear to have a power switch, or any kinds of controls, accessible from out here.
target: &715 从外面，似乎找不到电源开关或其他控制装置。

source: &582 What do I look like, an engineer?
target: &582 我看着像工程师吗？

source: &580 You can see a guard slumped over the desk, geared up the same way as the strike team at the factory.
target: &580 一个守卫瘫在桌前，装备跟工厂里的突击队一样。

source: &581 Through the window, you see a man who looks too well-armed to be working at a front desk. Closer than that is his mug of coffee.
target: &581 透过窗子，你看见一个男人。这么全副武装的人，怎么也不像前台工作人员。更靠近你的是他的咖啡杯。

source: &582 Vapor from the guard's coffee is carried by the breeze into the warm night air.
target: &582 守卫咖啡上的蒸气，被微风带进温暖的夜色。

source: &716 It looks like it could be opened, but not from the outside.
target: &716 应该能打开，但从外面不行。

source: &584 Nah. I don't want it now I know what's in it.
target: &584 不了。知道里面是什么以后，我不想要了。

source: &717 I can reach it, but he'd notice pretty quickly if I just took it.
target: &717 够得着，可我要直接拿走，他很快就会发现。

source: &584 Taking care to ensure the guard doesn't see, you squeeze a few drops of tranquiliser from the injector into the coffee.
target: &584 为了不让守卫看到，你小心地从注射器中挤出几滴镇静剂，滴进咖啡。

source: &717 The door leads into the terminal.
target: &717 这扇门通往货运站内部。

source: &718 Through the damage, you can make out an itinerary, some long-expired special offers, and a message where somebody's hacked the text to display rude ASCII drawings.
target: &718 透过损坏的地方，你能辨认出一份行程表、早已过期的特价广告，还有一条被人篡改的消息，显示着粗俗的ASCII图画。

source: &718 This screen's probably not connected into the higher systems.
target: &718 这块屏幕应该没连到上级系统。

source: &719 I'd better save my wetware for more important targets.
target: &719 湿件还是留给更重要的目标吧。

source: &2090 I can't reach it from here.
target: &2090 从这里够不着。

source: &719 You recognize the model of aerostat - it's the same type that the Mindjacker escaped to from the top of Animus Organics.
target: &719 你认出了浮空艇的型号，与意识劫持者从阿尼姆斯有机公司楼顶逃走时乘坐的型号相同。

source: &720 An aerostat is tethered to the landing field. Through the fence, you can see dock-workers loading crates of cargo.
target: &720 一艘浮空艇系在起降场上。透过围栏，你看到码头工人正在装载货箱。

source: &720 I can smell his coffee from here.
target: &720 在这里就能闻到他的咖啡。

source: &585 Real subtle.
target: &585 真隐蔽啊。
